name: @omp-dev-team/token-diet
description: Token-reduction toolkit for OMP: ctx-wire + CodeGraph + caveman + yagni.
comment: Ships an MCP server (CodeGraph), an always-on rule (codegraph routing + ctx-wire note), four skills (codegraph, caveman, yagni, token-diet), and a setup script. No omp.extensions — the heavy lifting is external binaries (ctx-wire, codegraph) wired via .mcp.json + rules; ctx-wire is transparent (PATH shims/hook, no prefix).
